items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Ben Webster. ... How was the experience of working in his band? ... I worked with a lot of combos. ... you worked with Ben Webster.

ctx.x: They called me there -- see, they didn't let -- call too many musicians. What I mean, that particular outfit was led by Clarence [Rawls] who was a sergeant in the Army, and called guys like Joe Turner on piano. Naturally, he wanted Sy Oliver over there. And Bob Carroll, used to hang out there at the Rhythm Club. And -- who was unbelievably -- just a cruel, big rascal. He and Ben Webster, I was told, I heard about it, got in the darndest fight. And Ben Webster liked that. He blackened everything he could find on…
